## Always-on AI review and local fallback

- Require AI review during P&ID scans, using the configured provider first and bundled Ollama if it is unavailable or fails.
- Bundle the Ollama runtime and download its vision model on first launch.
- Distribute Windows builds as an app-folder ZIP to avoid extracting the large runtime on every launch; update in place without replacing user job files. Windows installations from v0.1.27 or earlier must download and extract this ZIP manually.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.27...v0.1.29
